tools.name: list-pair-matches
tools.description: List matches played by a pair of players. Returns each match with its tournament, round, both teams with their players and seeds, scheduled time, court, status, score, winner and duration. To get the player IDs, use the "search-players" tool.

tools.name: list-player-matches
tools.description: List the matches of a player by providing their player ID. Returns each match with its tournament, round, both teams with their players and seeds, scheduled time, court, status, score, winner and duration. To get the player ID, use the "search-players" tool.

tools.name: list-player-rankings
tools.description: Get ranking snapshots for a player by providing their player ID. Each entry includes the ranking type (official/race/elo/earnings), position, points and diffs against the previous snapshot. tools.name: list-rankings
tools.description: Get the ranking list for a given week. Without `date` returns the latest snapshot; with `date` returns the snapshot in effect at that day. tools.name: list-tournament-matches
tools.description: List the matches of a tournament by providing the tournament ID. Returns each match with its round, both teams with their players and seeds, scheduled time, court, status, score, winner and duration. To get the tournament ID, use the "search-tournaments" tool.

tools.name: search-headtohead
tools.description: Search head-to-head matches between two teams, or all matches of one team (one or two player IDs per team). Returns each match with its tournament, round, both teams with their players and seeds, scheduled time, court, status, score, winner and duration, most recent first. To get the player IDs, use

tools.name: search-matches
tools.description: Search matches by ID, date, round, category, draw or tournament level. Returns each match with its tournament, round, both teams with their players and seeds, scheduled time, court, status, score, winner and duration. To list all matches of a tournament, use the "list-tournament-matches" tool.

tools.name: search-pairs
tools.description: List pairs of professional padel players that have played at least one match together. Returns the pair ID, players, status (`current` if it is the active pairing of both players, `former` otherwise), combined ranking points (only for current pairs) and the dates of their first and most recent match

tools.name: search-players
tools.description: Search players by ID, name, nationality, category, birthplace or side. Returns the player ID, name, category, nationality, current ranking and points, Padel API Elo, height, side (drive/backhand), hand, birthplace, birthdate and age.

tools.name: search-seasons
tools.description: Search seasons by ID or year. Returns each season with its name, start and end dates, status and number of tournaments. Seasons from 2023 onwards are available.

tools.name: search-tournaments
tools.description: Search tournaments by name and other filters to get tournament details: location, venue, country, level, format (pairs or teams), status, court type, prize money, dates and poster image.

tools.name: show-match-live
tools.description: Get point-by-point details for a specific match ID. Returns the play-by-play score data for each set and game, available both during live matches and after they have finished. Only available for matches of these tournament levels: finals, fip_other, fip_platinum, major, p1, p2.

tools.name: show-match-stats
tools.description: Get detailed match statistics for a specific match ID. Returns per-team stats for the match and for each set: points won, break points converted, longest streak, aces, double faults, and points won on first/second serve and return. Only available for matches of these tournament levels: finals, fip_o

tools.name: show-pair-stats
tools.description: Get statistics for a pair of players by providing their player IDs. Returns matches played and won, win percentage, sets and games won/lost, titles, finals, semifinals and best round. To get the player IDs, use the "search-players" tool.

tools.name: show-pair-synergy
tools.description: Get the synergy of a pair of players by providing their player IDs: results together against what their Elo ratings predicted. tools.name: show-player-stats
tools.description: Get career statistics for a player by providing their player ID. Returns matches played and won, win percentage, sets and games won/lost, titles, finals, semifinals and best round. To get the player ID, use the "search-players" tool.
